description: This file contains functions for creating and manipulating date objects from arrays, including handling week-based dates and converting arrays to date instances within the Moment.js library.

methods.name: currentDateArray
methods.description: Returns the current date as an array [year, month, day], using UTC or local time based on configuration.

methods.name: configFromArray
methods.description: Converts an array of date components into a Date object, handling special cases like day of year and week-based dates.

methods.name: dayOfYearFromWeekInfo
methods.description: Calculates the day of the year from week information in the configuration object.
